cli.usage:
Usage: sheetcraft <command> [project-dir] [options]

Commands:
  validate                    Validate all tables. Exits with 1 if there are errors
  export [--force] [--tables <table,...>] [--out <dir>] [--format json|yaml|csv|protobuf]
                              Write the output files. Nothing is written if there are errors, unless --force is given
                              Without --format, output.format in the project settings is used
  new <table> [--display-name <name>]
                              Create a table template with the common columns
  fmt [--check]               Rewrite all files in the canonical form. With --check, only check them
  convert --to yaml|json      Change the format of the resource files

Common options:
  --lang ja|en                Language of the messages (default: ja)
  -h, --help                  Show this usage

If project-dir is omitted, the current directory is used.
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 validation errors or --check mismatch, 2 usage errors or load failures
cli.error.notProject: {dir} is not a project folder (sheetcraft.yaml or sheetcraft.json is missing)
cli.error.missingTableName: Specify the name of the table to create
cli.error.invalidTableName: The table name "{name}" is not allowed. Use lowercase letters, digits and _, not starting with a digit
cli.error.invalidOutputFormat: --format must be json, yaml, csv, or protobuf ({value} was given)
cli.error.brokenTables: Cannot convert because some tables have load errors: {paths}
cli.export.blocked: Nothing was written because there are validation errors (use --force to write anyway)
cli.export.blockedForce: Nothing was written because some names cannot be exported as Protocol Buffers (even with --force)
cli.fmt.ok: All files are in the canonical form
cli.fmt.skipped: Not rewritten because of load errors: {path}
cli.convert.done: Changed the format of the resource files to {format}
